page_title: FRE 2-2 BAY | Freiburg v Bayern Munich 01/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Sven Jablonski is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Lucas Holer (Freiburg) for his blatant foul.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Noah Atubolu is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.

87' 2 - 2 Lucas Holer (Freiburg) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes inside the left post. He couldn't have done it any better. 2:2.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maximilian Eggestein leaves the pitch and Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) comes on.

83' What a chance! Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) squanders a promising opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the right post!
83' Thomas Tuchel has decided to substitute Jamal Musiala and he is replaced by Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich).
80' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
79' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sven Jablonski had an easy-decision to make.
77' Substitution. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Roland Sallai walks off.
77' Christian Streich has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) replacing Ritsu Doan.
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Thomas Muller will be replaced by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich).

75' 1 - 2 An amazing individual effort from Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 1:2. Noah Atubolu was helpless.
73' This is a yellow card! Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
72' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) produces a clever header from around the penalty spot, but it's stopped by one of the defending players.
72' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayern Munich.

71' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Noah Atubolu is alert and denies him with a nice save. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayern Munich will take a corner.
70' The corner is swung in but Bayern Munich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
70' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and Bayern Munich manage to earn a corner.
67' Bayern Munich fail to score from a corner as Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) leaps to collect the ball.

67' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
66' The resulting corner from Christian Gunter (Freiburg) comes to nothing.
65' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Freiburg.
64' A substitution has been made. Vincenzo Grifo goes off and Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) comes on.
64' Thomas Tuchel prepares a substitution. Joshua Kimmich is replaced by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Raphael Guerreiro as he is replaced by Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich).
63' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar.
61' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) commits a foul after dangerous play.
60' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
59' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) launches a cross from the corner, but Manuel Neuer is alert to thwart the effort.

57' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. It will be a corner kick for Freiburg.
56' The Bayern Munich players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
50' Bayern Munich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

50' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Bayern Munich force a corner. They send men into the box.
48' Close! Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the resulting free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper dives to his right and denies the effort. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Noah Atubolu shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
43' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the right post.
42' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
41' The game is interrupted as Christian Gunter (Freiburg) is flagged offside.
38' The resulting corner, taken by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), comes to nothing.
38' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Good work from Bayern Munich as they win a corner.

35' 1 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
35' Bayern Munich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

35' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
32' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
28' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle and it's Christian Gunter (Freiburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
27' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
25' PENALTY APPEAL after Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
22' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post.
21' The total number of attempts is 7:1.
18' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
16' The resulting set piece from Freiburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

16' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Manuel Neuer pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The referee signals a corner kick to Freiburg.
15' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
12' 1 - 0 Goal! Christian Gunter (Freiburg) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom right corner. It's 1:0.
12' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) gets to a rebound in the six-yard box and his effort smashes off the crossbar.

12' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Manuel Neuer shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
10' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is flagged for offside.
9' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
5' The linesman signals that Roland Sallai (Freiburg) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
4' Great teamplay by Bayern Munich as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Freiburg will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Sven Jablonski.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
